records.issue_text: Public group-members route is limited to 50 members but the members template has no pagination or load-more UI, so larger groups silently display only the first 50 members.
records.rationale: The diff shows the groups_controller.rb members action now has a default limit of 50 (`limit = (params[:limit] || 50).to_i`). Looking at the public group/members.hbs template, it iterates over `{{#each m in members}}` but there's no pagination UI added to this template - only the admin template (group.hbs) got pagination controls with next/previous buttons.
